description: Presets offered under "More options" in the New Site dialog (components/sites/CreateSiteDialog.vue). `runtime` picks PHP, Node.js or a static site; `docRootSuffix` is the sub-folder of the project folder the web server serves; `nodePort` and `nodeStartCommand` fill the Node.js fields. Labels and hints live in the locale files under sites.create.template.<id>. Keep IDs stable.
